segments.t: What changed in the current release. The version this guide was built for is shown in the footer.

KTPH000Continue a run in an AI chatKTPH001 — when a terminal run has finished, a bar under the terminal offers KTPH002Continue in AI chatKTPH003 and a field for a follow-up question; the run menu of every agent design has the same entry. The chat starts with the task and the final answer, and lists the steps of the run (commands, exit codes, shortened output) in a collapsed KTPH004StepsKTPH005 list. Everything stored is masked, including a sudo password typed during the run. See KTPH006Continue a run in an AI chatKTPH007.

KTPH000AI agent profileKTPH001 — a new KTPH002AI agent profileKTPH003 role under KTPH004AI KTPH008 AI Manager KTPH009 Local AI KTPH010 Profile rolesKTPH005 picks the profile terminal agent runs use when neither the run nor the connection names one; left empty, runs keep using the Coding profile and then the default profile. See KTPH006Local AI manager settingsKTPH007.

KTPH004Searching the AI ManagerKTPH005 — a search line above the AI Manager's tabs finds an option on any page, opens the page and highlights it; KTPH006KTPH000KTPH007+KTPH008KTPH001KTPH009 / KTPH010KTPH002KTPH011+KTPH012KTPH003KTPH013 jumps to it. See KTPH014Searching the AI ManagerKTPH015.

KTPH000AI chats in the journalKTPH001 — while the journal records, an KTPH002AI agentKTPH003 card continued in an AI chat gets an KTPH004AI chatKTPH005 tag, an KTPH006Open in AI chatKTPH007 button and a collapsible transcript with the steps of the run. The journal keeps a masked copy that follows the chat until the journal stops, so a deleted chat still opens read-only from it. Exports get an KTPH008Include AI chatsKTPH009 option: an appendix in PDF, a file per chat beside Markdown, the transcript in HTML bundles. See KTPH010AI agent cards and their AI chatsKTPH011.

KTPH003Summaries per commandKTPH004 — the AI summarizer reads the log command by command and never splits one, so a long KTPH000 becomes one entry instead of a dozen. Replies typed into a running program belong to their command; typos and commands that only show help, such as KTPH001 or KTPH002, are left out of the cards and of the KTPH005CommandsKTPH006 count. A long command is condensed or, with chunking, read in full in several prompts; a command still running gets a KTPH007still runningKTPH008 entry after 15 minutes. With shell integration korTTY knows each command's exact end and exit status. See KTPH009AI summariesKTPH010.

KTPH000Finishing in the backgroundKTPH001 — the closing pass of a journal runs in the background and shows as KTPH002finishingKTPH003 in the journal manager; a journal left unfinished by quitting korTTY or a crash is finished at the next start.

KTPH000Re-evaluation in the backgroundKTPH001 — KTPH002Re-evaluate with AI…KTPH003 keeps running when you close its window or the journal manager. The progress window shows the current step, a progress bar, the elapsed time and an estimate of the time left; the journal manager shows the run in a status line with KTPH004Show progressKTPH005 and KTPH006CancelKTPH007. See KTPH008Re-evaluating a journal with AIKTPH009.

KTPH000Scrollbars on the journal pageKTPH001 — the log panel has a visible scrollbar of its own, every scrollbar thumb stays at least 40 px long, and the scrollbars of excerpts no longer show through the docked log panel.

KTPH000Structure panelKTPH001 — KTPH002StructureKTPH003 in the snippet editor toolbar shows a panel left of the code with the classes and functions, the variables (kind, scope, first line, usages) and the placeholders of the snippet. Click an entry to select it in the code; the tree follows the caret and a filter narrows all three lists. See KTPH004Structure panelKTPH005.

KTPH001LuaKTPH002 — Lua is a snippet language with highlighting, completion and structure rules, also in the file editor of the SFTP manager. KTPH003Format CodeKTPH004 uses StyLua and KTPH005Check SyntaxKTPH006 uses KTPH000 when they are installed. See KTPH007Format CodeKTPH008.

KTPH002Installed formatters found from the FinderKTPH003 — Black, RuboCop, StyLua and the other formatters you install yourself are also found in the usual install folders such as KTPH000 and KTPH001, so they work when korTTY was started from the Finder or the Dock.
